context: Both fixes are on main. Each machine needs one catch-up update, then one turn to prove the decision watch judges it.
ref: c58 (mods update themselves) and c29 (the decision watch runs again)
steps: In a terminal: claude plugin marketplace update claude-settings
Then: claude plugin update <mod>@claude-settings for each mod (claude plugin list shows them).
Restart the app, take one turn, and check that shadow.log has a new line.
Reply with each machine's mod versions, or just 'done'.
title: Update the claude-settings mods and check the decision watch on the Mac and Windows
